method.exact_columns: Hurwitz-closed engine formula on every closed Acb source-contour arc; target center retained in the binomial sum for every k
method.deep_integral: sum |u_n*b_n|; first term plus integral with n-exponent 2*sigma+1. More generally binomial term m has exponent 2*sigma+m; the full centered power does not have exponent 2*sigma+k because its m=0 term is nonabsolute.

R2.B_total_formula: sum exact b_k for k=0..K_head plus certified analytic tail from K_head+1
